definitions.explanation: A piece that has broken off from something, especially glass, pottery, or other hard materials.

examples.japanese: ガラスの{破片|はへん}で{指|ゆび}を{切|き}ってしまった。
examples.english: I cut my finger on a piece of broken glass.

examples.japanese: {爆発|ばくはつ}で{破片|はへん}が{飛|と}び{散|ち}った。
{考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}が{土器|どき}の{破片|はへん}を{発見|はっけん}した。

notes:
{破片|はへん} refers to pieces broken off from a larger object, typically hard materials like glass, pottery, metal, or stone.

Common collocations:
- ガラスの{破片|はへん} (glass fragment/shard)
- {土器|どき}の{破片|はへん} (pottery fragment)
- {金属|きんぞく}{破片|はへん} (metal fragment)
- {破片|はへん}が{飛|と}ぶ (fragments fly)

Related terms:
- {欠片|かけら} (piece, fragment - more general, often written in hiragana)
- {断片|だんぺん} (fragment, piece - also used figuratively for memories, information)
